title: Serene Mist
description: Layered washes of sage and slate dissolve into morning fog — a quiet study of distance, light and stillness.

title: Contours of Silence
description: Bold, re-stated contours and smudged mass — a gestural figure study about the weight of a pause.

title: Earth & Ether
description: Terracotta, sand and charcoal pigment built up in heavy impasto — earth below, a dark sun suspended above.

title: Still Life in Graphite
description: A classical still life of vessel, cube and sphere, built with cross-hatching to model light falling across form.

title: Monsoon Coast
description: Slanting rain over a dark headland — the heavy, silver light of the first monsoon evening on the coast.

title: Fern Study
description: Three unfurling fronds drawn from life — patient, repetitive line work tracing the geometry of a fern.
